name: Carmen
beschreibung:
Located in the idyllic mountain village of Finkenberg in the Zillertal, the family-run Pension Carmen welcomes guests with genuine Tyrolean warmth and comforting amenities. The lovingly furnished rooms feature modern conveniences and balconies with panoramic views of the Zillertal Alps.

With convenient access to cable cars and the year-round Hintertux Glacier, it serves as an ideal base for skiing, scenic hikes, and alpine climbing tours in every season.
kurzbeschreibung: Pension Carmen in Finkenberg offers cosy alpine rooms and warm Tyrolean hospitality in the Zillertal valley.
